title: They Gave Anne Boleyn One Day To Die. She Made It Last Five Hundred Years.
description:
She has been awake since two in the morning. The candle is nearly gone.
It is the nineteenth of May, fifteen thirty-six. The Tower is quiet. She asked for the sword herself.

This is a slow, cinematic recreation of Anne Boleyn's final hours inside the Tower of London — the delays, the waiting, the silence, and the single stroke that ended a queen. The king tried to erase her from history. What he left behind undid him.

New episodes recreate the last hours of people and places history remembers. Subscribe if that's the kind of history you're here for.
